The current `fork record checks` workflow still invokes the historical October3 Docker-routing fixture. That fixture intentionally preserves its old `ghcr.io/rasteratops/build@` lookup. #413 added and qualified the current October4 fixture, but the workflow invocation was not updated.

Actual current failure: https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/actions/runs/37525738170/job/112482147665 . It fails at the shared Docker host/inner-run assertion after the old image lookup cannot locate the renamed pinned image. The actual QA19 watcher remains live; this is the hosted regression check's stale entrypoint.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: the existing isolated host fixture exercises actual runner/entrypoint code with simulated Docker. It does not require a handheld or real container. Hosted workflow readback supplies the integration proof.

- [x] Point fork CI at the already-qualified current fixture, preserving the historical fixture and failed evidence.
- [x] The current fixture passes its original routing/lifecycle and negative-control assertions on the exact changed checkout; retain command/results/process cleanup.
- [x] A normal fork push executes the corrected hosted step successfully. Report later independent gate failures separately; do not claim the whole workflow green without its result.

M7.P4 release-process follow-up to #413, discovered during #471 remediation's metadata readback. No product, frozen candidate, watcher process or instruction-file change is needed.

Verified on next `3e44680631aaf1b1b90ea9cb76a03dcbb706c11b` (feature `b2f545a68e910f91eb8c71296d20e1496fbfd27e`). Local sealed fixture: 35 PASS, 0 FAIL; all four results zero, sealed inputs unchanged, actual fixture/owner cleanup verified. [Hosted run](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/actions/runs/37527891607/job/112489445225) executes the October4 fixture and the watcher step passes. The separate audit-cadence ceremony step remains failed while #471 is open; the whole workflow is not green. Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-06-pixelelated-replacement-15/watcher-ci-01/`. Historical fixture and failed logs preserved.
